verdict.rationale: SumUp docs confirm a refund guide stating payments can be refunded partially or in full via the API (sumup-docs-16/23/35), implying dashboard/API refund capability, but evidence doesn't explicitly confirm refund initiation from the POS terminal itself or a dedicated dashboard UI flow. missing for 10: explicit POS-terminal refund flow documentation, dashboard UI screenshots/steps, independent/hands-on confirmation of refund success.
